# Skopje revolutionary district

The Skopje revolutionary district (Macedonian/Bulgarian: Скопски револуционерен округ) was an organizational grouping of the Internal Macedonian Revolutionary Organization. The most prominent leaders of the group were Petar Poparsov, Bano Kushev and Andrej Kozhuharov. This rebel group was active in northern Vardar Macedonia with headquarters in Skopje.
